title: Dubai & Abu Dhabi Explorer
shortDescription: Six days across two Emirates — Dubai's icons and desert, plus Abu Dhabi's Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Louvre Abu Dhabi and Ferrari World.
description: Add the elegance of Abu Dhabi to the energy of Dubai. After four days of skyline views, souks and desert adventures, you'll move to the capital for a night — time enough to see the luminous white marble of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque at sunset.
Spend the next day choosing between the art and architecture of the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the thrills of Ferrari World on Yas Island, before heading home with the best of both Emirates.

price.note: Includes UAE tourist visa. Flights quoted separately.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dubai
itinerary.description: Airport pick-up and transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure — perhaps a stroll along the Dubai Creek or JBR beach.

itinerary.title: Dubai city tour & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: Explore old Dubai's souks and Al Fahidi district, cross the Creek by abra and see Jumeirah's landmarks. Head up the Burj Khalifa in the afternoon and watch the Dubai Fountain show.

itinerary.title: Desert safari
itinerary.description: Free morning. In the afternoon, a 4x4 dune drive, camel ride and sandboarding, then a BBQ dinner with live entertainment at a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Free day in Dubai
itinerary.description: A day for shopping, a theme park or the beach. Optional add-ons include the Museum of the Future or a seaplane flight.

itinerary.title: To Abu Dhabi — Grand Mosque at sunset
itinerary.description: Drive to Abu Dhabi (approx. 1.5 hours). After check-in, visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in the late afternoon, staying as the white marble turns gold and the lights come on.

itinerary.title: Louvre or Ferrari World, then depart
itinerary.description: Choose between the Louvre Abu Dhabi on Saadiyat Island or the rides of Ferrari World on Yas Island, before your transfer to Abu Dhabi or Dubai airport.

inclusions: 4 nights in Dubai and 1 night in Abu Dhabi (4-star) with breakfast
Dubai city tour and Abu Dhabi city tour with Grand Mosque visit
Louvre Abu Dhabi or Ferrari World ticket
All transfers on a private basis
knowBeforeYouGo: Modest clothing covering arms and legs is required at the Grand Mosque; women need a headscarf
Passports must be valid for 6 months from your travel date
